question: Should the bundled Anthropic plugin expose local Claude CLI/Desktop transcripts across the Gateway and paired nodes by default to authenticated operator.write clients?
rationale: Existing scopes authenticate the caller, but default remote access to third-party local transcripts and default startup activation are intentional product-security choices that automation cannot authorize.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep Claude session federation disabled until the user intentionally enables it or approves the added pairing capability.

options.title: Approve default read-only access
options.body: Accept the current operator.write and pairing boundary after focused security, upgrade, and live proof review.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Do not land cross-host Claude transcript browsing until a narrower exposure model is agreed.

recommendation.title: Require explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep Claude session federation disabled until the user intentionally enables it or approves the added pairing capability.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the adjacent session fleet and transcript architecture and are the only high-confidence current-main history owner for this new surface.
